thread:
Maria Chen: quick sanity smoke for new onboard (sage-mini-v3). I tried loading weights from gs://redwood-weights/sage-mini-v3/2026-03-10/model.bin and tokenizer 'sentinel-chat-v2' — token counts look off (BOS present in both inputs + truncation). pinging @Andrew @Sneha. TL;DR: need config check & confirm trim flags.

Andrew Li: thanks — can you paste the model config? also which tokenizer version? sometimes sentinel-chat-v1 vs v2 changes BOS/EOS tokens.

Maria Chen: pasted config: 
```yaml
weights_gcs: gs://redwood-weights/sage-mini-v3/2026-03-10/model.bin
tokenizer: sentinel-chat-v2
default_max_tokens: 1024
preserve_bos: true
trim_sentinels: auto
```
I saw extra <bos> token when using chat template: `<BOS><user>{user}</user>{msg}<EOS>`

Sneha Patel: looks like preserve_bos true + template already adds BOS => double. Try `preserve_bos: false` or strip template BOS. Also check tokenizer `special_tokens` map for empty-string sentinel.

Juan Gomez: small heads-up: weights path has a symlink to /staging/; infra says stable path is `gs://redwood-weights/sage-mini-v3/stable/model.bin` — we should use 'stable' for Dedicated onboarding.

deploy-bot: infra-check — weights file checksum mismatch with registry. Run `gcloud storage cp gs://redwood-weights/sage-mini-v3/2026-03-10/model.bin ./tmp && sha256sum ./tmp/model.bin` to confirm.

Kyra Singh: quick repro steps I ran: 
1) `redwood-cli token-count --model gs://redwood-weights/sage-mini-v3/2026-03-10/model.bin --prompt "hello"`
2) output: tokens=6; expected 5; shows extra sentinel `\uE000` at start
=> tokenizer seems to map BOS to U+E000 for sentinel-chat-v2.

Maria Chen: noted. I'll re-export tokenizer with sentinel mapped to `<s>` and re-run. Also cc @eng-oncall in case model fails validation.

Andrew Li: For config validation, add `tokenizer_version: 2` and run `redwood-cli validate-config --path ./onboard.yaml` — that'll catch preserve_bos vs template conflicts.

Sneha Patel: I'll update the PR with the config fix and add a tiny unit test for template rendering. Should I target canary or direct to stable?

Maria Chen: canary first, please. Also leave a note in the onboarding checklist: 'verify stable weights path + tokenizer special_tokens don't duplicate BOS/EOS'.

Kyra Singh: LGTM. If anyone's blocked I'll pair — 30m slot at 11:30 PT.

Juan Gomez: I can switch weights to stable path once CI green.

Maria Chen: thanks all :raised_hands: I'll update the onboard doc and ping again after re-export. If infra-check still fails, I'll open an incident.
